summary: Configured node1 with persistent 512 MiB zstd-compressed zram swap at maximum priority 32767. It activated successfully during a verified node reboot, and the host recovered healthy.
actions_performed: Configured /dev/zram0 for 512 MiB using zstd compression and swap priority 32767.
Verified the live swap and systemd boot-target wiring.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed zram swap automatically recovered after reboot with no failed systemd units.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap
evidence.summary: /dev/zram0 reports 536,866,816 bytes (512 MiB), zstd compression, and active [SWAP] status before and after reboot.
The generated swap unit is wired into swap.target; the new boot journal directly records creation, formatting, and activation of /dev/zram0.
The zram swap is active at priority 32767, the kernel's maximum swap priority. Pre-reboot inspection also confirmed no disk-backed swap was configured.

Healthy baseline boot ID 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a was captured, safe reboot acknowledged, and the new boot ID 2bddbb3a-671f-4b8d-944d-82f10eeecd8c proved restart. Post-restart state was running, both zram units were active, swap retained the requested size/compression/priority, and zero systemd units had failed.
